provenance.asset_description: A ransom note reading: We have your nosy agent she’s poked her tusks into our business for the last time! If you want to see her safe return bring 1,000,000 Platinum, a bagful of Osiriani gold, and the rightful property of the Red Mantis assassins to the docks at the assigned time. Otherwise expect to see her teeth at your doorstep. Signed Acheakek’s Finest
